The useful inquiry is method-specific, not the −2500 moneyline.

cards.rationale: Olascuaga is the proven 12-1 WBO flyweight champion with five prior defenses, but Martinez is a two-time Olympian, 2016 silver medalist and 7-0 professional with seven stoppages. Martinez was already training for a Nov. 20 bout when offered this title shot, so the professional record gap overstates the preparation gap. Sports Interaction's direct 1.14/5.00 pair normalizes Olascuaga near −439; paying about −714 without an independent fair or standing target is not justified.
